content.comment_body: Whenever I attempt to connect to the [product_name], it crashes and restarts automatically. During this period, [product_name] software keeps trying to connect and then shows the error 'cannot connect to the remote device.' Could insufficient power be causing this issue? When I use the test function, the software manages to connect briefly, but the hardware crashes and restarts immediately, and after 15-20 seconds, the error reappears. Any advice is appreciated. I am using [product_name] software [version_no] and an older [product_name] hardware [version_no].
You need to provide more information. Which [product_name] do you have exactly? Please specify the exact [article_no]. Also, how are you trying to connect—through Ethernet or using a dedicated cable?
Hello, thanks for the fast reply. Here are the details: Main [product_name]: [article_no]; Extension module: [article_no]. I am using an Ethernet cable to connect to the [product_name].

I haven't encountered this type of error before. Are you certain that the power supply wiring is correct? Have you checked if the cable ends are properly inserted and the connectors' screws are tightly fastened?

The power supply is fine and wired correctly. When I went to check the [product_name] today, I noticed the main module lost power momentarily before it came back on. I inspected the cable ends and realized one connection wasn't tight enough, so I fixed it. I haven't attempted a new connection yet, but I suspect this might resolve the issue. I’ll update you next week after another visit with my computer. Thanks again for your prompt assistance.
